article.title: Liability for expenses necessary for preservation of easement.
article.content: The expenses incurred in constructing works, or making repairs, or doing any other act necessary for the use or preservation of an easement, must be defrayed by the dominant owner.
article.html:
25Liability for expenses necessary for preservation of easement.

Section 25 · Chapter III · page 12 of the Act

The expenses incurred in constructing works, or making repairs, or doing any other act necessary for the use or preservation of an easement, must be defrayed by the dominant owner.
